environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'ci-artifacts' with default service account. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with no securityContext restrictions. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP, accessible from any pod in the cluster. No network policies applied. The container filesystem is writable with no read-only root filesystem enforcement. EXTRACT_DIR is set to /app/uploads but traversal allows writing to /etc/cron.d, /root/.ssh/authorized_keys, or overwriting application binaries.
